fields.jurisdiction: City of Westport post-earthquake evaluation program

elements.element: Second-floor bearing wall at the stair
elements.damage: Shear cracks across about 40 percent of the wall

fields.findings: The stair wall can be shored and repaired. The rest of the building shows light damage.
fields.restrictions: Ground floor and floors 2 and 3 away from the stair bay may be occupied after shoring is installed and checked. The stair bay stays closed.
fields.recommendation: Install shoring at the stair wall, then reinspect. The repair design is by the engineer of record.
